title: Around the Log
scenario: A tool action can bypass the normal application request logger, leaving no durable audit event.
objective: Require auditable records for all tool actions and route them to an append-only sink.
ai_native_dimension: Agent/tool activity exposes an observability blind spot; the learner determines what cannot be reconstructed after the fact.
deliverables: audit_policy.json requires audit for all actions
aar_questions: What was the security problem in Around the Log and what objective evidence proved it?
What was the risk if it remained unresolved?
What did you change and why?
How did you verify the result independently of AI output?
Where did AI help, where was it wrong/incomplete, and what remained your responsibility?
